meta.title: Zi Wei Dou Shu Workbench
meta.description: Professional Zi Wei Dou Shu charting and reading workbench: solar/lunar birth charts with palaces, stars, transformations and decades. Open it from the sidebar (Zi Wei Dou Shu Pro) and use Reading for a quick reading or a 14-part report. Charts are computed locally; interpretation sends the chart and birth data to your configured model provider. Traditional interpretation, not scientific advice.
